evidence: Menu title is 24px with line-height 16.8px (0.7). Its two lines ("...구운 버섯" / "샐러드 세트") overlap by about 12px vertically at both 360 and 393 px, so the glyphs collide and the second line is hard to read.
fix: Set line-height to about 1.3 (31px) on #menu-title.

evidence: The nutrition row forces 4 cards of 104px onto one line. The 4th card (나트륨 2,140mg) starts at x=352 and ends at x=456, and main clips it with overflow:hidden. At 360px only a 8px sliver shows; at 393px the text starts at x=365 and is still cut. Sodium is not readable.
fix: Use a 2x2 grid (grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr)) or let the row wrap, as in a 2-column layout.

evidence: The absolutely positioned BEST badge (x=57-98, y=636-658) sits on top of the size name #opt-size-large-name (x=63-150). The option reads "BEST (1.5인분)" and the word "라지" is hidden at both widths.
fix: Render the badge inline after the name (position: static; margin-left: 6px) or move it to the card corner outside the text box.

evidence: The chip has a fixed width of 104px with white-space:nowrap and overflow:hidden. The label needs about 150px (122px text + 28px padding), so it shows "아주 매운맛 +1,0" and hides the price.
fix: Remove the fixed width (width: auto) so the chip sizes to its label, or allow it to wrap.

evidence: The spice warning (that the level cannot be changed after cooking starts and is not recommended for children) is set at 10px, much smaller than the surrounding 14-16px text, and is hard to read on a phone.
fix: Raise it to at least 13px, matching the other helper text.

evidence: The "리코타 치즈" row has margin-top 4px, while every other topping row has 16px. The gap above it is 4px against 16px elsewhere, which is visibly uneven.
fix: Remove the margin override so the row uses the list default of 16px.

evidence: The page is 1731px tall with no bottom padding for the 77px fixed #cart-bar. At maximum scroll (scrollY 951 at 360x780) the last option "일회용 수저·포크 받기 / 무료" (doc y 1655-1709) is still under the cart bar, so it can never be seen or tapped. Same at 393x852.
fix: Add bottom padding to main at least as tall as the cart bar plus a gap, e.g. padding-bottom: calc(77px + 16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)).

evidence: The H1 has white-space:nowrap. The text is 567px wide in a 328px column and is cut at the viewport edge, reading "바람길 물류가 배차 확정 시간을 4". The rest of the title is not visible at 360 or 393px.
fix: Remove white-space:nowrap so the title wraps (white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere for long words).

evidence: The callout has margin-top -30px. Its top (y=543) sits above the bottom of #summary-body (y=573), so the box covers the last line of the summary ("...시간에서 1시간 46분으로 줄었어요.").
fix: Use a positive margin-top (e.g. 16px) so the callout starts below the paragraph.

evidence: The value "1시간 46분" is 28px with white-space:nowrap. It is 123px wide inside a 104px stat card (80px content box at 360px, 115px card at 393px) with overflow:hidden, so it shows as "1시간 46" and the unit is cut.
fix: Allow the value to wrap (white-space: normal) or scale it down, e.g. font-size: clamp(20px, 6vw, 28px).

evidence: The section heading is 22px with line-height 15.4px (0.7). Its two lines overlap by about 11.6px and are unreadable ("처음 세운 가설 세 가지를 모두 내려놓고 / 종이 배차표부터 다시 그린 이유").
fix: Set line-height to about 1.35.

evidence: The body of "배운 점" is set at 10px, while other article paragraphs use 16px. It reads like fine print and is hard to read on a phone.
fix: Use the article body size (16px, line-height 1.65).

evidence: Step 3 has margin-left 4px. Its number badge and text start at x=20, while steps 1, 2 and 4 start at x=16, so the numbered list is visibly jagged.
fix: Remove the margin-left on #step-3.

evidence: "휴무 반영 누락" has margin-top 6px, while the other result rows have 20px. The gap above it is 6px against 20px elsewhere.
fix: Remove the override so the row uses margin-top: 20px.

evidence: The page is 2073px tall with no bottom padding for the fixed 77px #cta-bar. At maximum scroll (1293 at 360x780, 1221 at 393x852) the last related case (doc y 1974-2065, "중고 가구 플랫폼의 검수 대기 시간을...", "커머스 · 9분 분량") stays behind the CTA.
fix: Add bottom padding to the article at least as tall as the CTA bar plus a gap (about 100px plus the safe-area inset).

evidence: main starts the page title at y=40-76, but the fixed header.top is 64px tall. At load the H1 "세일즈 2팀 주간 성과" is mostly hidden under the header and only the bottom 12px of the glyphs show.
fix: Offset main by the header height, e.g. padding-top: 104px (64px header + 40px).

evidence: Tabs have a fixed width of 84px, no horizontal padding, nowrap and overflow:hidden. "리텐션 코호트 분석" needs 104px, so it is cut to "리텐션 코호트 !" and butts against the "리포트" tab.
fix: Size tabs to their content (width: auto; padding: 0 16px).

evidence: The churn delta line is nowrap at 13px and needs about 375px, but the KPI card leaves 279px with overflow:hidden. It is cut mid-word at "...해지 38건 중 21건이 연간 플".
fix: Allow wrapping (white-space: normal) so it breaks onto two lines inside the card.

evidence: The "휴가" badge is absolutely positioned at x=547-584, y=612-634 with margin-top -11px. It covers the owner name #cell-owner-4-name (x=519-567), so the row reads "남궁/ 휴가" and the name cannot be read.
fix: Make the badge inline (position: static) with margin-left: 6px after the name.

evidence: The insight headline is 20px with line-height 14.4px (0.72). Its two lines overlap by about 9.6px ("이번 주 전환율 하락은 대부분 신규 리드 유입 / 채널 한 곳에서 시작됐어요").
fix: Set line-height to about 1.35.

evidence: The goals panel has margin-left 3px. Its left edge is at x=1003 and it is 397px wide, while #panel-detail and #panel-insight sit at x=1000 with a 400px width, so the right column edge is visibly uneven.
fix: Remove the margin-left so all right-column panels share x=1000.

evidence: The system activity row ("주간 목표 리포트가...") has margin-top 8px, while the other rows have 20px. The gap above it is 8px against 20px elsewhere.
fix: Remove the override so the row uses margin-top: 20px.

evidence: Content starts at y=0 under the fixed 56px #co-header. At load the delivery ETA headline "10월 20일(월) 오전 7시 전 도착 예정" (y=24-49) is completely hidden behind the header, and only part of the next line shows.
fix: Add padding-top equal to the header height plus a gap (about 80px) to .app.

evidence: The delivery address is white-space:nowrap. It is 552px wide inside a 294px box with overflow:hidden and no ellipsis, so it stops at "...바람채아파트 101동" and the unit number and gate code are invisible at 360 and 393px.
fix: Let the address wrap (white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere).

evidence: The headphone price cell is 62px wide with nowrap and overflow:hidden, but "1,249,000원" needs 79px. The price displays as "1,249,00" at 360px and is cut similarly at 393px.
fix: Let the price keep its natural width (width: auto; flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap) and let the name column flex instead.

evidence: The coupon conditions (minimum amount, dawn-delivery exclusion, refund rules) are set at 10px. These are important purchase terms and are hard to read.
fix: Use at least 13px with line-height 1.5.

evidence: The installment table is 405px wide in a 328px column. The 4th column "총 납부 금액" (x=343-413) extends past the 360 and 393px viewports and is clipped by .app overflow:hidden with no horizontal scroll, so the total for each plan (1,217,400원 / 1,292,480원) cannot be read.
fix: Fit the table to the column (width: 100%; tighter cell padding; table-layout: fixed) or wrap it in an overflow-x: auto container.

evidence: The shipping row has padding-left 5px. Its label "배송비" starts at x=21, while the other payment-summary labels start at x=16, so the label column is visibly misaligned.
fix: Remove the padding-left on #sum-row-shipping.
